title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.21290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors.

translated_title: FM-Recon：探索基础模型特征用于加速心脏电影MRI重建
translated_abstract: 基础模型在各类医学影像任务中已展现出强大的特征提取能力，但其在MRI重建中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索，尤其是在展开式重建网络以及输入受伪影污染的情形下。在本工作中，我们探索预训练基础模型的特征是否以及如何能够有益于加速心脏电影MRI重建。为此，我们提出了FM-Recon，这是一个将基础模型冻结图像编码器提取的特征进行精炼并整合到展开式重建网络中的框架。通过在CMRxRecon2023数据集上的大量实验，我们系统地评估了基础模型特征在不同重建设置下的表现。结果表明，基础模型能够从受伪影污染的输入中提取有信息量的表征并提升重建性能，尤其是在中等加速倍数下。
tldr: 提出FM-Recon框架，将预训练基础模型冻结编码器的特征精炼并整合到展开式重建网络中，显著提升加速心脏电影MRI的重建质量，尤其在中等加速倍数下效果突出。
en_tdlr: FM-Recon refines and integrates features from a frozen pretrained foundation model encoder into an unrolled reconstruction network, improving accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction quality, particularly at moderate acceleration factors.
